record.field:
SENCROP · Odoo Integration

Official API base URL: https://api.sencrop.com/v1

1) Connection

Type: REST

Authentication handled via API token configured in the Remote Control record.

connection_params example:

{
  "Authorization": "Bearer <API_TOKEN>"
}

2) Device & Sensor Configuration

Uses standard Odoo models:

  • Device: mdm.measurement.device
  • Sensor: mdm.measurement.device.sensor

Each sensor must define in remotecontrol_params a JSON with:

{
  "device_id": "124295",
  "measure": "SOIL_MOISTURE_20CM"
}

Parameters:

  • device_id: Sencrop device numeric ID
  • measure: One of the measures supported by the device

3) Workflow

  1. Get Devices Plan
    Builds bag["sensors_plan"] with one entry per sensor, containing:
    • sensor_id (Odoo sensor)
    • device_id (Odoo device)
    • device_code (Sencrop device id)
    • measure
  2. Get Readings Data
    For each plan entry, calls: 
    /devices/{device_id}/measures/{measure}
    and processes returned observations.

4) Device Matching Logic

Devices are matched using the Sencrop device ID, not the name.

  • The ID is taken from remotecontrol_params.device_id
  • This avoids issues with Unicode names or renamed devices

5) API Response Format

Typical Sencrop response:

{
  "values": [
    {
      "date": "2025-12-17T10:00:00Z",
      "value": 23.6
    }
  ]
}

6) Data Conversion

  • value: converted to float
  • date: converted from ISO format to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

7) Database Upsert Logic

Each observation is upserted into:

mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading

Unique key:

{
  "sensor_id": SENSOR_ID,
  "measurement_time": TIMESTAMP
}

Stored values:

  • value
  • remotecontrol_origin_id

8) Date Window for Fetching Data

The fetch window is computed per sensor:

  1. Last imported reading date + 1 day
  2. Otherwise: 01/01/{current_year}

To date:

{today}T23:59:59

9) Error Handling

  • Missing device_id or measure → sensor skipped
  • No values returned → no data for that period
  • Invalid numeric value → reading skipped and logged
  • HTTP / API error → logged and counted

10) Execution Sequence

  1. Get Devices Plan (sequence 10)
  2. Get Readings Data (sequence 20)

11) Audit & Logging

After execution, a JSON audit file is attached to the Remote Control record containing:

  • Execution timestamp
  • Total readings processed
  • Total upserts
  • Total errors
  • Per-sensor details (URL, points, errors)

Attachment name format:

sencrop_readings_fetch_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json

A message is also posted on the Remote Control:

[Sencrop Readings] upserts=X errors=Y

import json import base64 from datetime import datetime from datetime import timedelta
Remote = self.remote_id SensorModel = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = []
partner_id = bag.get('partner_id') token = bag.get('token') if not token or not partner_id: raise Exception("Token or partner_id missing in bag")
base_url = 'https://api.sencrop.com/v1'
now_utc = datetime.utcnow() before_date = now_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
for sensor_plan in plan: sensor_id = sensor_plan['sensor_id'] device_id = sensor_plan['device_id'] device_code = sensor_plan['device_code'] measure = sensor_plan['measure']
sensor_record = SensorModel.browse(sensor_id)
url = "%s/users/%s/devices/%s/data/raw?size=1000&beforeDate=%s&measures=%s" % ( base_url, partner_id, device_code, before_date, measure, )
headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % token, 'Accept': 'application/json', }
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=60) code = resp.status_code full_url = getattr(resp, 'url', url) if code >= 400: total_errors += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'device_code': device_code, 'measure': measure, 'status': code, 'url': full_url, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], }) continue
payload = resp.json() or [] if not isinstance(payload, list): total_errors += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'device_code': device_code, 'measure': measure, 'status': code, 'url': full_url, 'error': 'Response is not a list', }) continue
upserts = 0 errs = 0 readings_summary = []
for obs in payload: raw_value = obs.get('value') raw_ts = obs.get('date')
try: dt_obj = datetime.strptime(raw_ts, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z") measurement_time = dt_obj.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") except: measurement_time = None
try: valf = float(str(raw_value).replace(',', '.')) except: valf = None
if measurement_time and valf is not None: try: Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', { 'sensor_id': sensor_record.id, 'measurement_time': measurement_time, }, { 'value': valf, 'remotecontrol_origin_id': Remote.id, }, ) upserts += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': measurement_time, 'value': valf, }) except Exception as e: errs += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': measurement_time, 'value': valf, 'error': str(e), }) else: errs += 1 readings_summary.append({ 'ts': raw_ts, 'value': raw_value, 'error': 'Invalid measurement_time or value', })
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs
items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'device_code': device_code, 'measure': measure, 'status': 200, 'url': full_url, 'points_found': len(payload), 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'readings': readings_summary, })
except Exception as e: total_errors += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'device_id': device_id, 'device_code': device_code, 'measure': measure, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, }
try: audit_json = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, default=str) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')) except Exception as json_error: simple_audit = { 'executed_at': str(fields.Datetime.now()), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'error': str(json_error), } audit_json = json.dumps(simple_audit, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) b64 = base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8'))
fname = 'aca_readings_fetch_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':','').replace('-','').replace(' ','_')
att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post(body=u"[ACA Readings] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id])
bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
